svg.title: Desk node on a dot board
svg.text: 1000 uF: LONG leg into the +5V bus (19,12),
striped SHORT leg into the GND bus (23,12)
solid thick red / dark grey: a BUS - one bare tinned wire laid along the pads on the UNDERSIDE, soldered at every pad
dashed: an insulated link wire on the underside. Its bare end wraps round the header pin before that pin is soldered
amber: the diode's own leg, bent along four pads under the board - the 470 ohm and the green DIN wire solder onto it
Numbers are hole positions, counted from the top-left corner of the board: (column, row). Nothing is wired to 3V3.
Only three ESP32 pins are used: VIN, GND (the one below VIN) and RX2. The other GND stays free.
Two buses 4 holes apart. Nothing bare may cross the gap between them.
